GitHub/Vercel data file
=======================

1. Open Settings in the app.
2. Click "Export for GitHub" / "Export cho GitHub".
3. Copy the downloaded toeic-data.json file into this directory.
4. Commit and push the file to GitHub, then wait for Vercel to redeploy.

A browser with no local TOEIC Tracker data will load toeic-data.json
automatically. On a browser that already has local data, use
Settings -> Load GitHub data so local progress is not overwritten silently.

Privacy: toeic-data.json is publicly accessible when the deployed Vercel site
is public. Do not include sensitive notes.
